newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean Jan-Aug beef imports fall 1.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean Jan-Aug beef imports fall 1.4 pct.

text.p: South Korean beef imports for the first eight months fell 1.4 percent to 105,145 tonnes this year from 106,621 tonnes a year ago, an official at the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry said on Wednesday.
"It is 71.5 percent of our total import quota this year under the World Trade Organisation's agreement," the ministry official said.
"This year's beef imports will exactly match the Minimum Market Access quota of 147,000 tonnes," he added.

Traders said the U.S. supplied 54 percent, or 56,874 tonnes, of this year's total imports followed by Australia with 26.95 percent or 28,332 tonnes, Newzealand with 16.1 percent or 16,993 tonnes and Canada with 2.8 percent or 2,946 tonnes.

Under the World Trade Organisation's Minimum Market Access agreement, South Korea must import 167,000 tonnes of beef in 1997, 187,000 tonnes in 1998, 206,000 tonnes in 1999 and 225,000 tonnes in 2000.
South Korea has said the market will be opened in 2001.
